enrichments.obs_text: The codes of the mind set on something are G5426 (to set one's mind on; to have a certain attitude; to be minded) in Rom 8:5 and G5427 (purpose, frame of thought, will, aspirations, with Rom 8:6 named) in Rom 8:6. The lexicon bears out a set of mind directed on an object, the flesh or the Spirit.
enrichments.grounds: purpose, frame of thought, will, aspirations
